'''Antoine Crespo Travesset'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Crespo|Travesset}} (born 15 November 1955) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1976 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1976 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/cr/antoine-crespo-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418083717/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/cr/antoine-crespo-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Antoine Crespo |accessdate=17 March 2018 |quote=Full name: Antoine Crespo Travesset}}</ref>
